# Historical recovery fixture — not the current app

This immutable v0.5.4 archive is retained only for hash-verified recovery and
historical algorithm comparisons. It is not DOM v0.5.28, a current installer,
or a development baseline. Do not install it or copy its application over DOM.

`docs/recovery-manifest.json` records its SHA-256 and original file hashes.
Current application source is `src/`; current app identity is in `package.json`.
